qualification: QEMU's 32-bit Arm virt machine with NOR flash under UBI. Boot trust none: U-Boot checks the FIT's hashes and no signature, since QEMU supplies its control device tree and no key can be embedded in it. The kernel requires signed root/support verity (DM_VERITY_VERIFY_ROOTHASH_SIG, dm_verity.require_signatures=1). The boot test boots U-Boot and the kernel from a flash image under QEMU, with trial counting and both record copies read back. This does not qualify physical flash, NAND or any hardware debug policy. Development signing inputs only; not a release target.

evidenceRefs.ref: mica-build:src/image/kernel-package.ts (the kernel component refuses a kernel without built-in DM_VERITY_VERIFY_ROOTHASH_SIG and an embedded content anchor) and mica-build:boards/qemu-armhf/tests/boot/run.sh (make -C boards/qemu-armhf boot-test)

physicalBoundaries.jtag: Virtual machine; no JTAG/SWD port exists. QEMU's gdbstub is the host operator's and Mica OS controls none.
physicalBoundaries.serialConsole: QEMU's PL011 (ttyAMA0), with a login prompt only; no account accepts a credential (mica:docs/design/access.md section 2).
physicalBoundaries.recoveryPath: Rewrite of the flash image on the host; the virtual machine has no other recovery path.
